skill_name: Compare and contrast unsupervised and supervised learning models.
workflow: Unsupervised learning is a type of machine learning algorithm that does not use labelled data. Unsupervised learning models are used for clustering data, uncovering patterns in data, and making predictions. Supervised learning, on the other hand, uses labelled data in order to make predictions. Supervised learning models are used to predict outcomes, classify data, and identify individual objects in data sets.
